title: Fast-Convergent Proximity Graphs for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search

statements.text: Let $P$ be a set of $n$ points and $G$ be the $α$-CG of $P$. Consider any query point $q$ whose exact NN in $P$ is $v^*$. ; If $ (q, v^*) $, a greedy routing on $G$ can find $v^*$ in $O((α· )^ · log log_α )$ time. ; Otherwise, a greedy routing on $G$ can find an $( α+1 α-1 + )$-ANN of $q$ in $O((α· )^ · log log_α (α-1) )$ time, for any $ > 0$. The $α$-CG $G$ has space $O(n· (α )^ log )$ and can be constructed in $O(n^2· ((α )^ log + log n))$ time.
